analyst.summary: Redtape delivered strong revenue and profit growth in FY26 across its footwear-led, apparel-and-accessories portfolio, with full-year margins improving. The most recent quarter showed even faster revenue growth, though the earnings call also flagged some margin pressure and rising inventory sequentially, which is worth monitoring. The company carries more debt than a typical high-quality consumer brand, though returns remain healthy. We rate this a Hold: a genuine growth story, but with real working-capital leverage and a valuation that leaves little room for missteps.
